title: WO chains require host-proved full recovery points before retry spend and fresh-base readiness
steps: Request an existing failed WO retry with no verified full backup and inspect model calls and brief state.
Finish fresh provisioning with missing full backup while model preparation is pending; compare a healthy parallel build.
Run the public accepted Retry worker with the exact backup refusal and inspect its terminal action code.
expect: A known bad retry makes zero paid preparation calls and preserves the failed brief.
A fresh unsafe base aborts preparation and never applies; healthy model preparation remains parallel with provisioning.
Only host-proved full metadata passes, and the public retry ends once with SITE_RECOVERY_POINT_UNAVAILABLE.
Cancellation while a bench start is pending cancels its eventual queued run before polling or export.
Brand preparation cancelled before the first round makes no paid model call and opens no round.
fence: optional chain base-validation hook before retry restart and base readiness, using existing verified backup door

tests: an existing failed WO retry refuses a missing full baseline before any paid preparation
fresh WO base failure aborts parallel preparation and never becomes ready or applies
healthy fresh WO keeps base and model preparation parallel and applies after full-baseline validation
WO base validation reads host-proved full backup metadata and refuses file-only or unavailable points
a public chain Retry with no full recovery point ends with its exact refusal without restarting the writer
a bench run created after chain cancellation is cancelled before polling or export
a chain cancelled before bench creation never queues a run
a cancel asked while brand preparation is pending prevents the first paid call
